restore.//: Restore NuGet packages for the API.

build.//: Build the Trax + HotChocolate GraphQL API (net10.0).

db.//: One-shot: bring up the atlas Postgres (docker compose up -d). Terminates, so it is a valid dependsOn for serve and for downstream live-data targets.

db:down.//: Stop the Postgres container (keeps the volume). Add --volumes to also drop seeded data.

serve.//: Run the GraphQL server at http://localhost:55250/trax/graphql (self-seeds Scryfall on first run). dependsOn db brings Postgres up first; the server itself is long-running, so it can never be a dependsOn of anything else — depend on 'db' or a future one-shot 'data' target instead.

watch.//: Hot-reload dev server (dotnet watch run) at :55250.
